fusions.name: Pried Plates
fusions.desc: Strands work into the joints of the target's armour and wrench it open, dealing 28 piercing damage that ignores armour and leaving the target 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Scouring Wool
fusions.desc: Scrubs a mass of wire-stiff strands across every enemy within 2.5 tiles for 4 slashing damage. Each hit has a 25% chance to leave its target [Sundered] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Plaited Mail
fusions.desc: Plaits your hair into a coat of mail that absorbs the next 22 damage and holds for 8 seconds. Your armour rises by 10% while it holds.

fusions.name: Lacquered Lamellae
fusions.desc: Conjures armour of lacquered plaits laid in overlapping rows: every hit you take is 2 lower, your armour rises by 10%, your maximum health rises by 10, and 6% of the damage you take goes back to whoever dealt it.
